title: Tafiya a ƙasar Hausa
description: Ten short stories about travelling in Hausaland: a reckless taxi ride to a Kano motor park, a fake cotton jacket at a Kaduna second-hand market before a trip to cold Jos, a Katsina farmer's long-awaited pilgrimage to Mecca, a family day at Yankari with lions, gazelles and the Wikki spring, a city girl in her grandmother's village kitchen near Gombe, a Fulani herder and his son moving their cattle south, a Lagos boy at the Kano Sallah Durbar, a retired teacher's journey for his pension, an American student in Kano, and the clay Nok heads in the Jos museum.

lessons.title: Tasi zuwa gareji
lessons.summary: In Kano, Sahabi takes a taxi to the motor park to travel to his sister's wedding in Zaria; the driver drives recklessly, leaves no gap and never uses his indicator, and within two seconds a bus hits them: Sahabi cuts his forehead and a girl breaks her arm; the ashamed driver pays for her treatment, and a calm old driver takes Sahabi to the motor park.
lessons.text:
Sahabi matashi ne mai shekara 25 da yake zaune a Kano. Ranar Juma'a ya shirya zai tafi Zaria, domin za a yi auren ƙanwarsa ranar Asabar. Da sassafe ya fita bakin titi, ya tsayar da wata tasi. Ya ce wa direban, "Don Allah, kai ni gareji, inda motocin Zaria suke tashi."

Direban ya ce, "Shiga, malam. Ba za mu daɗe ba."

Sahabi ya shiga tasin, ya zauna a baya kusa da wata mace da 'yarta. Tasin ta tashi da gudu. Nan da nan Sahabi ya gane cewa direban yana ganganci. Yana gudu sosai a cikin gari, yana shiga tsakanin motoci, ba ya barin rata tsakaninsa da wasu. Idan zai juya hagu ko dama, ba ya kunna sigina. Motocin da ke bayansu suna ta busa ƙaho.

Sahabi ya ce masa, "Malam, don Allah ka rage gudu. Ka bar rata tsakaninka da motar da ke gabanka. Kuma ka riƙa kunna sigina idan za ka juya."

Direban ya yi dariya. "Kada ka damu. Shekara ashirin ina tuƙin tasi a Kano. Ban taɓa yin haɗari ba."

Matar da ke kusa da Sahabi ta ce, "Wannan ganganci ne. 'Yata tana jin tsoro."

Amma direban bai saurare su ba. Da suka kai wata babbar mahaɗa, sai ya juya dama ba tare da sigina ba. Cikin sakan biyu kacal, wata motar haya ta bugi tasin a gefe. Sahabi ya bugi goshinsa a jikin kujerar da ke gabansa. Hannun yarinyar ya bugi ƙofa da ƙarfi. Uwarta ta yi ihu.

Mutane suka taru. Jini yana zuba daga goshin Sahabi. Wani mutum ya kira motar asibiti, kuma bayan 'yan mintoci ta iso. A asibiti, likita ya duba hannun yarinyar, ya ce, "Akwai karaya a ƙashin hannunta. Za ta buƙaci jiyya har tsawon makonni shida." Sai ya duba goshin Sahabi, ya ce, "Kai ba ka da karaya. Raunin goshinka ƙarami ne. Za a ɗinke shi, kuma bayan jiyya na kwana uku za ka warke."

Direban ya zo asibitin, kansa a ƙasa. Ya ce wa uwar yarinyar, "Na yi kuskure. Ganganci na ne ya jawo wannan haɗari. Zan biya kuɗin jiyyar 'yarki."

Matar ta ce, "To, shikenan. Allah ya sa ka koyi darasi."

Bayan an ɗinke goshinsa, Sahabi ya sake tsayar da wata tasi zuwa gareji. A wannan karon direban tsoho ne mai natsuwa. Yana tafiya a hankali, yana barin rata, yana kunna sigina a kowace mahaɗa. Da suka isa gareji, Sahabi ya biya shi, ya ce, "Na gode, baba. Haka ake tuƙi."

A gareji ya sami motar Zaria, ya isa gida da yamma. Da ƙanwarsa ta ga goshinsa, ta ce, "Me ya same ka?" Ya ba ta labarin, sai ta ce, "Shikenan, Allah ya kiyaye. Abin da ke da muhimmanci shi ne ka zo lafiya."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Sahabi zai tafi?
Zai tafi Zaria domin auren ƙanwarsa.
Me direban farko yake yi?
Yana ganganci: yana gudu sosai, ba ya barin rata, kuma ba ya kunna sigina.
Me ya faru cikin sakan biyu?
Wata motar haya ta bugi tasin a gefe.
Wa ya sami karaya?
Yarinyar ce ta sami karaya a hannunta.
Me ya sa Sahabi ya gode wa direba na biyu?
Domin yana tuƙi a hankali, yana barin rata, kuma yana kunna sigina.

lessons.title: Jaket daga kasuwar gwanjo
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, before a December trip to cold Jos, Najiba and her friend Farha go to the second-hand clothes market; a cheat shows her a jacket with a label stuck on it saying pure cotton, Farha lifts it with her fingernail and finds a nylon label underneath, and the sleeve tears when he snatches it back; an honest old woman sells her a skirt and a half-cotton jacket.
lessons.text:
Najiba tana zaune a Kaduna. A watan Disamba za ta tafi Jos domin ta ziyarci 'yar uwarta. A Jos akwai sanyi sosai a lokacin hunturu, amma Najiba ba ta da jaket mai kauri. Sai ƙawarta Farha ta ce mata, "Mu je kasuwar gwanjo. A can ake samun jaket mai kyau da araha."

Kasuwar gwanjo babba ce. Kayan da ake sayarwa a cikinta tsofaffin tufafi ne daga Turai da Amurka. Ana kawo su Najeriya a cikin manyan buhuna. Masu sayarwa sun cusa kaya da yawa a kowane buhu. Idan mutum ya zo, sai su fitar da kayan daga buhu, su shimfiɗa su a kan tebur.

Najiba da Farha suka tsaya a gaban wani mai sayarwa. Ya fitar da wani jaket baƙi daga cikin buhu. A jikin jaket ɗin akwai wata ƙaramar takarda da aka liƙa. A kan takardar an rubuta "Auduga zalla" da farashi: naira dubu goma sha biyar.

Mai sayarwa ya ce, "Wannan jaket na auduga ne. Zai kare ki daga sanyin Jos."

Farha ta ɗauki jaket ɗin, ta taɓa shi. Ta kalli takardar da aka liƙa, sai ta ga gefenta ya ɗago. Ta sa farcenta a ƙarƙashin takardar, ta cire ta. A ƙarƙashinta akwai wata tsohuwar takarda da aka rubuta "Roba" a kanta.

Farha ta ce, "Ka gani! Wannan jaket ba na auduga ba ne, na roba ne. Kai ne ka liƙa wannan sabuwar takarda a kai. Wannan damfara ce."

Mai sayarwa ya ce, "Ƙarya kike yi, ba ni na liƙa ta ba!" Ya fizge jaket ɗin daga hannunta da ƙarfi, sai hannun jaket ɗin ya tsage.

Najiba ta ce, "Duba, hannun ma ya tsage!" Suka bar shi. Farha ta ce, "Wannan mutumin mayaudari ne. Mayaudari yakan yi wa mutane damfara domin ya san ba sa dubawa sosai."

Suka wuce zuwa wani wuri. A can wata tsohuwa tana sayar da siket da jaket. Ba ta cusa kayanta a buhu ba. Ta rataye su, kowanne da farashinsa. Najiba ta ga wani siket mai launin shuɗi, ta tambayi tsohuwar, "Wannan siket na auduga ne?"

Tsohuwar ta ce, "Eh, siket ɗin na auduga ne. Amma wannan jaket ɗin rabinsa auduga ne, rabinsa roba."

Najiba ta duba jaket ɗin sosai. Babu inda ya tsage. Ta taɓa ɗinkinsa da farcenta, ta ga yana da ƙarfi. Ta sayi siket da jaket ɗin a kan naira dubu takwas.

Suna komawa gida, Farha ta ce, "Ki tuna, a kasuwar gwanjo kada ki yarda da takardar da aka liƙa. Ki duba da idonki, ki taɓa da hannunki."

Washegari Najiba ta cusa sabon jaket da siket ɗinta a cikin jakarta, ta hau mota zuwa Jos.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Najiba take son jaket?
Domin za ta tafi Jos, kuma a Jos akwai sanyi sosai a lokacin hunturu.
Me aka rubuta a kan takardar da aka liƙa a jikin jaket ɗin farko?
An rubuta "Auduga zalla" da farashi.
Yaya Farha ta gane damfarar?
Ta cire takardar da farcenta, sai ta ga wata takarda a ƙarƙashinta da aka rubuta "Roba".
Me ya faru da jaket ɗin da mai sayarwa ya fizge shi?
Hannun jaket ɗin ya tsage.
Me Najiba ta saya a wurin tsohuwar?
Ta sayi siket na auduga da jaket.

lessons.title: Hajjin Alhaji Mujibu
lessons.summary: Near Katsina, the farmer Mujibu has saved for thirty years and always paid his zakat; when his name is called for the pilgrimage his eagerness and cheerfulness show; the muezzin Malam Sallau teaches the pilgrims that hajj is a spiritual journey to follow the Prophet's sunnah, and at Mecca and Arafat Mujibu prostrates and thinks of the Day of Resurrection.
lessons.text:
Mujibu manomi ne a wani ƙauye kusa da Katsina. Shekara talatin yana tara kuɗi domin ya je aikin hajji. Kowace shekara bayan girbi yakan fitar da zakka, ya raba wa talakawan ƙauyensu. Bai taɓa barin zakka ba, domin yana da amanna cewa zakka tana tsarkake dukiya, kuma ba ta rage ta.

A wannan shekara kuɗinsa sun isa. Da aka sanar cewa sunansa yana cikin mahajjatan jihar Katsina, ɗokinsa ya yi yawa. Matarsa Hajiya Mairama ta ce, "Duba fara'ar fuskarka! Tun da na aure ka ban taɓa ganin ka da irin wannan fara'a ba." Mujibu ya ce, "Ai ɗoki ne. Shekara talatin ina jiran wannan rana."

Kafin tafiyarsu, ladan na masallacin ƙauyen, Malam Sallau, ya tara mahajjatan ƙauyen. Ladan ɗin ne yake kiran sallah a masallacin tun yana matashi, kuma ya taɓa zuwa hajji sau biyu. Ya ce musu, "Hajji ba tafiya ce kawai ba. Tafiya ce ta ruhaniya. Jikinku zai je Makka, amma zuciyarku ma dole ta tafi. Ku bi sunnar Annabi a kowane mataki. Sunna ita ce hanyar da Annabi ya bi a rayuwarsa."

Mujibu ya tambaya, "Malam, ta yaya zan san sunna a wurin da ban taɓa zuwa ba?"

Malam Sallau ya ce, "Za a ba ku malamai masu jagora. Ku tambaye su a kowane lokaci. Kuma ku yawaita sujada. A sujada ne bawa ya fi kusa da Ubangijinsa."

Ranar tafiya, mahajjata ɗari uku suka taru a filin jirgin sama. Duk suna sanye da fararen kaya, fuskokinsu cike da fara'a. Wasu suna kuka saboda ɗoki. Jirgin ya tashi da dare, ya sauka a Saudiyya da safe.

A Makka, Mujibu ya ga dubban mahajjata daga ƙasashe daban daban. Wasu baƙaƙe ne, wasu farare, amma duk suna yin sujada tare a lokaci guda. Mujibu ma ya yi sujada, ya yi kuka. Ya ji wani abu na ruhaniya da bai taɓa ji ba a rayuwarsa.

Ranar Arafat, mahajjata suka tsaya a fili tun daga rana har zuwa faɗuwar rana. Mujibu ya tuna da abin da Malam Sallau ya faɗa: "Tsayuwar Arafat tana tuna wa mutum ranar kiyama, ranar da kowa zai tsaya shi kaɗai a gaban Allah." Ya ga miliyoyin mutane a fili guda, kowa yana addu'a. Sai ya ce a ransa, "Haka ranar kiyama za ta kasance."

Bayan ya ziyarci Madina, Mujibu ya dawo gida. Da ya sauka a ƙauyen, Malam Sallau ne farkon wanda ya tarbe shi. Mujibu ya ce masa, "Malam, gaskiya ka faɗa. Hajji tafiya ce ta ruhaniya. Na dawo da amanna mai ƙarfi fiye da ta da."

Tambayoyi:
Me Mujibu yake yi da zakka kowace shekara?
Yakan raba ta wa talakawan ƙauyensu.
Me ya sa Hajiya Mairama ta yi magana a kan fara'ar mijinta?
Domin ba ta taɓa ganin sa da irin wannan fara'a ba.
Wane ne Malam Sallau?
Shi ne ladan na masallacin ƙauyen.
Me Malam Sallau ya ce game da sunna?
Ya ce sunna ita ce hanyar da Annabi ya bi a rayuwarsa, kuma su bi ta a kowane mataki.
Me tsayuwar Arafat take tuna wa mutum?
Tana tuna masa ranar kiyama.

lessons.title: Rana guda a Yankari
lessons.summary: From Bauchi, a father takes Khalifa and his little sister Siham to Yankari; the guide Malam Raufu shows them gazelles, a resting lion and vultures hovering on spread wings and says the wolves were hunted out long ago; they swim in the Wikki spring with their towels, find cans and rubbish left by visitors, and collect it all into the bin.
lessons.text:
Khalifa yaro ne ɗan shekara goma sha biyu, ƙanwarsa Siham kuma 'yar shekara tara ce. Suna zaune a Bauchi tare da iyayensu. A lokacin hutun makaranta, mahaifinsu ya kai su gidan namun daji na Yankari.

Kafin su tafi, mahaifiyarsu ta ce, "Ku ɗauki tawul. A Yankari akwai wani ruwan ɗumi mai suna Wikki, kuma ana nunƙaya a cikinsa." Kowanne ya sa tawul a jaka.

Da suka isa, wani jagora mai suna Malam Raufu ya tarbe su. Ya hau motar tare da su, suka shiga daji. Ba a daɗe ba suka ga barewa biyar suna cin ciyawa. Siham ta ce, "Kalli barewa! Suna da kyau sosai." Malam Raufu ya ce, "Barewa tana da sauri ƙwarai. Idan ta ji motsi, sai ta gudu."

Suka ci gaba da tafiya. A gefen wani tafki suka ga zaki yana kwance a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya. Khalifa ya ce, "Malam, zaki ba zai kawo mana hari ba?" Malam Raufu ya ce, "Muddin muna cikin mota, babu matsala. Wannan zaki ya ci abinci, yanzu yana hutawa. Zaki yakan yi barci kusan duk rana."

A sama kuma wasu manyan tsuntsaye suna shawagi. Fiffikensu a buɗe suke, ba sa motsa su sosai. Siham ta tambaya, "Me ya sa suke shawagi a kanmu?" Malam Raufu ya ce, "Ungulu ne. Suna shawagi suna neman nama. Duba girman fiffikensu! Idan suka buɗe fiffike, sai iska ta ɗauke su."

Khalifa ya tambaya, "Akwai kerkeci a nan?" Malam Raufu ya ce, "A da akwai kerkeci a wannan daji, amma yau shekaru da yawa ba a ga kerkeci ba. Mafarauta sun kashe su duka."

Da rana ta yi zafi, suka je ruwan Wikki. Ruwan yana da tsabta har ana ganin ƙasa. Yaran suka shiga ruwan, suka yi nunƙaya har suka gaji. Siham ba ta iya nunƙaya sosai, sai Khalifa ya koya mata.

Bayan sun fito, suka goge jikinsu da tawul. Sai Siham ta ga gwangwani a gefen ruwan. Wasu baƙi sun sha lemo, sun jefar da gwangwani a ƙasa. Akwai kuma bola da yawa: ledoji, takardu da ragowar abinci. Wannan dauɗa ta ɓata kyan wurin.

Malam Raufu ya yi baƙin ciki. Ya ce, "Mutane suna zuwa daga nesa domin su yi nunƙaya a nan, amma wasu suna barin bola. Wannan dauɗa tana cutar da dabbobi. Barewa tana iya cin leda, ta mutu."

Khalifa da Siham suka ɗauki wata jaka, suka tattara gwangwani goma sha biyu da sauran bola, suka zuba su a cikin kwandon shara. Malam Raufu ya ce, "Kun yi abin kirki. Da kowa zai yi haka, da babu dauɗa a Yankari."

Da yamma suka koma Bauchi. A cikin mota Siham ta ce, "Baba, shekara mai zuwa mu dawo. Ina so in ga zaki kuma, in yi nunƙaya."

Tambayoyi:
Me mahaifiyarsu ta ce su ɗauka?
Ta ce su ɗauki tawul domin nunƙaya a ruwan Wikki.
Me tsuntsayen suke yi a sama?
Suna shawagi suna neman nama, fiffikensu a buɗe.
Me ya sa ba a ganin kerkeci a Yankari yanzu?
Domin mafarauta sun kashe su duka.
Me Siham ta gani a gefen ruwan?
Ta ga gwangwani da bola da yawa.
Me yaran suka yi da bolar?
Sun tattara ta, suka zuba ta a cikin kwandon shara.

lessons.title: Girkin kaka a ƙauye
lessons.summary: Inayatu from Abuja spends the school holiday in her grandmother's village near Gombe; she watches her cook millet porridge for breakfast on the three-stone hearth under a tamarind tree and sell fried bean cakes, winnow millet for gruel, clean goat intestines for a broth, and make a cake with the flour Inayatu brought from Abuja.
lessons.text:
Inayatu 'yar shekara goma sha huɗu ce, kuma tana zaune a Abuja. A lokacin hutu, iyayenta suka kai ta wani ƙauye kusa da Gombe, inda kakarta take zaune. Inayatu ba ta taɓa kwana a ƙauye ba. Kafin ta tafi, ta sayi buhun fulawa ƙarami, domin ta san kakarta tana son yin waina.

Da asuba, Inayatu ta farka, sai ta ji ƙamshin hayaƙi. Ta fita tsakar gida, ta ga kakarta a zaune a ƙarƙashin wata babbar itaciya. Itaciyar tsamiya ce, kuma inuwarta tana rufe rabin gidan. A gaban kakarta akwai murhu: duwatsu uku a kan wuta, kuma a kansu akwai tukunya.

"Kaka, me kike girkawa?" Inayatu ta tambaya.

"Koko ne," kakarta ta ce. "Da gero ake yin koko. Kowace safiya muna shan koko da ƙosai." Kusa da murhu akwai wani kasko mai mai, inda kakarta take soya ƙosai. Mutanen ƙauyen suka fara zuwa, suna sayen koko da soyayyen ƙosai. Inayatu ta sha koko a cikin ƙwarya, ta ci soyayyen ƙosai biyu, ta ce, "Kokon nan ya fi na Abuja daɗi!"

Bayan rana ta ɗaga, kakarta ta kawo gero a cikin wani faifai. Ta fara sheƙa shi: tana ɗaga faifan, tana zubar da geron a hankali, sai iska ta kwashe ƙura da ɓawo. Inayatu ta ce, "Kaka, bari in gwada." Ta sheƙa, amma geron ya zube a ƙasa. Kakarta ta yi dariya, ta ce, "A hankali. Ana koyon sheƙa kamar yadda ake koyon tafiya."

Da aka gama sheƙa, kakarta ta niƙa geron, ta yi kunu. Kunu ya fi koko kauri, kuma ana sa masa citta da kayan ƙamshi. Ta zuba kunu a cikin ƙwarya, ta ba Inayatu. "Sha," ta ce, "kunu yana ba da ƙarfi a lokacin zafi."

Da rana kawunta ya yanka akuya, domin baƙi suna zuwa. Kakarta ta ɗauki hanjin akuyar, ta wanke shi da ruwa sau da dama, ta cire dukan dauɗar da ke ciki. Inayatu ta rufe hancinta. "Kaka, za a ci hanji?"

"Ƙwarai kuwa," kakarta ta ce. "Hanji yana da daɗi idan an wanke shi sosai." Ta saka nama da hanji a cikin tukunya a kan murhu, ta zuba ruwa, albasa, barkono da gishiri. Da yamma romo mai zafi ya yi. Kowa ya sha romon, har Inayatu ma ta ce, "Wannan romo yana da daɗi sosai!"

Washegari Inayatu ta ce, "Kaka, na kawo miki fulawa daga Abuja." Kakarta ta yi murna. Ta haɗa fulawa da ƙwai da madara, ta gasa waina a cikin wata tukunya a kan murhu. Ta ce, "Da ma ba mu da fulawa a nan sai mun je kasuwar Gombe."

Da hutun ya ƙare, Inayatu ta koma Abuja. A gida ta ce wa mahaifiyarta, "Mama, shekara mai zuwa ma ina so in je wurin Kaka. Zan koyi sheƙa da yin kunu."

Tambayoyi:
Me ke ƙarƙashin itaciyar tsamiya?
Kakar Inayatu ce a zaune, kuma a gabanta akwai murhu.
Da me ake yin koko?
Da gero ake yin koko.
Me ya faru da Inayatu ta gwada sheƙa?
Geron ya zube a ƙasa.
Me kakarta ta yi da hanjin akuyar?
Ta wanke shi sosai, ta yi romo da shi.
Me Inayatu ta kawo daga Abuja?
Ta kawo fulawa, kuma kakarta ta yi waina da ita.

lessons.title: Tafiyar makiyaya
lessons.summary: At the start of the dry season the Fulani herder Bubakari and his fourteen-year-old son Usaini leave their settlement and walk their cattle south towards Adamawa; the heat grows fierce, a thorn pierces one goatskin water bottle and half the water streams out, at a river the boy dares to go in first and they push the frightened cows across with bamboo canes, and when the dusty wind dies down they build a new camp.
lessons.text:
Bubakari Bafulatani ne makiyayi. Yana zaune a wata ruga kusa da Katsina tare da iyalinsa da shanunsa. A ruga akwai bukkoki goma, kuma kowane iyali yana da garken shanu. Duk shekara, idan rani ya fara, ciyawa takan ƙare a kusa da rugar. Sai Bubakari ya kai shanunsa kudu, zuwa jihar Adamawa, inda ake samun ciyawa da ruwa.

A wannan shekara ɗansa Usaini, ɗan shekara goma sha huɗu, zai bi shi a karon farko. Usaini ya cika da murna. Mahaifiyarsa ta ba su salka biyu cike da ruwa. Salka jakar fatar akuya ce, kuma tana sanya ruwa ya yi sanyi ko da rana ta yi zafi. Bubakari ya ɗauki gora, Usaini ma ya ɗauki gora. Da gora makiyayi yake korar shanu.

Suka bar rugar da asuba. Kwana uku suna tafiya, amma a rana ta huɗu zafin rana ya yi ƙamari. Ƙasa tana ƙuna kamar wuta. Usaini ya ce, "Baba, zafin nan ya yi ƙamari. Ban taɓa jin zafi irin wannan ba."

Bubakari ya ce, "Ka sha ruwa kaɗan kaɗan. Ruwan salka dole ne ya isa har mu kai kogi."

Amma da suka tsaya a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya, Usaini ya ga ruwa yana kwararo daga gefen salka ɗaya. Wata ƙaya ta huda ta. Ruwan ya ci gaba da kwararo har rabinsa ya zube a ƙasa. Bubakari ya ɗaure wurin da igiya, ya ce, "Ba laifi. Za mu raba sauran ruwan."

Washegari suka isa wani babban kogi. Shanu suka tsaya a bakin ruwan, ba sa son shiga. Bubakari ya ce, "Dole mu ingiza su. Idan ɗaya ya shiga, sauran za su bi shi."

Usaini ya ce, "Baba, bari in fara shiga." Bubakari ya dube shi. "Ka kuskura ka shiga gaba?" Usaini ya ce, "Na kuskura. Na iya nunƙaya." Sai ya shiga ruwan, yana jan wani babban sa da igiya. Bubakari kuma ya bi shanun daga baya, yana ingiza su da gora. Ɗaya bayan ɗaya suka shiga, suka haye zuwa wancan gefen.

Da suka haye, sai wata iska mai ƙura ta taso. Ƙura ta rufe idanunsu, ba sa ganin komai. Suka zauna a ƙasa, suka rufe fuskokinsu da rawunansu. Bayan sa'a ɗaya, iskar ta lafa. Zafin rana ma ya lafa, sanyin yamma ya fara.

Bubakari ya kalli kogin, ya ce, "Kakana ma ya haye wannan kogi da shanunsa. Tun kafin a haife ni, makiyaya suna bin wannan hanya. Al'adar nan ba ta gushe ba har yau." Usaini ya ce, "Kuma ba za ta gushe ba, Baba. Ni ma zan kawo 'ya'yana nan."

A wannan dare suka gina sabuwar ruga a gefen kogin. Usaini ya cika salka da ruwan kogi, ya ajiye gora kusa da shi, ya yi barci.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Bubakari yake kai shanunsa kudu kowace shekara?
Domin idan rani ya fara, ciyawa takan ƙare a kusa da rugarsu.
Me salka take yi wa ruwa?
Tana sanya ruwa ya yi sanyi ko da rana ta yi zafi.
Me ya sa ruwa ya kwararo daga salka?
Domin wata ƙaya ta huda ta.
Wa ya kuskura ya fara shiga kogin?
Usaini ne ya kuskura ya fara shiga.
Me Bubakari ya ce game da al'adar makiyaya?
Ya ce al'adar ba ta gushe ba tun zamanin kakansa.

lessons.title: Hawan Sallah a Kano
lessons.summary: Ayman, born and raised in Lagos, comes to Kano for Sallah and goes to the Durbar with his cousin Abdulkuddus; they watch the palace guards' parade, the horsemen's feats as they gallop up and stop before the emir, and a flute player; Abdulkuddus explains that the tradition is centuries old, that the emirs' cavalry grew in the jihad that overthrew the old kings, and quotes the proverb that looking back adorns a journey.
lessons.text:
Ayman an haife shi a Legas, kuma a can ya girma. Iyayensa Hausawa ne daga Kano, amma ba ya zuwa Kano sai lokaci lokaci. A wannan shekara ya zo Kano domin bikin Sallah, kuma ya sauka a gidan ɗan uwansa Abdulkuddus.

Ranar Sallah, bayan an dawo daga masallaci, Abdulkuddus ya ce, "Tashi mu je hawan Sallah. Yau ne za ka ga daɗaɗɗen bikin Kano." Ayman ya ce, "Ban taɓa gani da idona ba."

Suka tafi ƙofar gidan sarki. Dubban mutane sun taru, wasu a kan bango, wasu a kan rufin gidaje. Abu na farko da suka gani shi ne maci. Masu gadin fadar sarki suka shigo a layi, sanye da jajayen kaya, suna tafiya tare kamar sojoji. Duk suna ɗaga ƙafa a lokaci guda. Ayman ya ce, "Wannan maci yana da kyau. Kamar macin ranar 'yancin kai a Legas."

Daga nan sai mahaya dawakai suka fara zuwa, kowace unguwa da tawagarta. Dawakansu suna da kayan ado masu launi. Wani mahayi ya sa dokinsa ya ruga zuwa gaban sarki da gudu, sai ya tsaya cak a gabansa, ya ɗaga takobinsa. Mutane suka yi ihu. Abdulkuddus ya ce, "Wannan bajinta ce. Kowane mahayi yana nuna bajintarsa a gaban sarki."

A gefen fadar akwai mawaƙa. Wasu suna busa kakaki, wani tsoho kuma yana busa sarewa. Sautin sarewar yana da daɗi, yana shiga zuciya. Ayman ya tambaya, "Me ya sa ake busa sarewa a nan?" Abdulkuddus ya ce, "Mawaƙan sarki suna yabon jaruntakar kakannin sarki da mahayansu."

Ayman ya tambaya, "Yaushe aka fara wannan hawa?"

Abdulkuddus ya ce, "Daɗaɗɗen biki ne, ya fi shekara ɗari biyu. Asalin hawan nan shiri ne na yaƙi. A lokacin jihadi na farkon ƙarni na goma sha tara, sarakuna sukan tara mahayansu, su nuna musu ƙarfinsu kafin su tafi yaƙi. Jihadin ne ya hamɓarar da tsofaffin sarakunan Hausa, aka naɗa sababbin sarakuna."

"To, wanda ya hamɓarar da sarakunan ne ya fara hawan?"

"Ba haka ba ne kai tsaye. Hawan ya canza da lokaci. Yanzu ba shirin yaƙi ba ne, biki ne. Amma mahayan suna tunawa da jaruntakar kakanninsu."

Da hawan ya ƙare, sai suka zauna a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya suna shan lemo. Ayman ya ce, "Na ji daɗi sosai. A Legas ban san tarihin nan ba."

Abdulkuddus ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Hausawa suna cewa: waiwaye adon tafiya. Wato idan mutum yana tafiya gaba, yana da kyau ya waiwayi baya, ya ga inda ya fito. Waiwaye ba ya hana ka ci gaba. Yana koya maka ka san kanka."

Ayman ya ce, "To, shekara mai zuwa ma zan dawo. Zan yi waiwaye kowace Sallah."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Ayman ya girma?
Ya girma a Legas.
Me ya faru a lokacin macin?
Masu gadin fadar sarki suka shigo a layi suna tafiya tare kamar sojoji.
Yaya mahayi ya nuna bajintarsa?
Ya sa dokinsa ya ruga zuwa gaban sarki, ya tsaya cak, ya ɗaga takobinsa.
Me jihadin ƙarni na goma sha tara ya yi?
Ya hamɓarar da tsofaffin sarakunan Hausa, aka naɗa sababbin sarakuna.
Me ake nufi da "waiwaye adon tafiya"?
Ana nufin idan mutum yana tafiya gaba, yana da kyau ya waiwayi baya, ya ga inda ya fito.

lessons.title: Fanshon Malam Ɗandume
lessons.summary: The retired teacher Malam Ɗandume travels by bus from Funtua to the pension office in Kaduna for the third time: an official treats the poor old pensioners with contempt while a rich man's papers are signed at once; he complains on the radio, the official accuses him of slander, and a commission ordered by the governor finds a solution that the executive council approves.
lessons.text:
Malam Ɗandume ya yi aikin malamin makaranta a Funtua har shekara talatin da biyar. Bayan ya yi ritaya, ya kamata gwamnati ta riƙa biyansa fansho kowane wata. Amma wata goma ke nan ba a biya shi ba. Saboda haka ya hau mota zuwa Kaduna, inda ofishin fansho yake. Wannan ne karo na uku da yake wannan tafiya.

Da ya isa ofishin, ya sami tsofaffi da dama a zaune a ƙasa a waje. Yawancinsu matalauta ne. Wasu sun zo daga nesa, sun kwana a gareji. Wata tsohuwa ta ce masa, "Mijina ya mutu, kuma fanshonsa ne kawai abin da muke ci. Shekara ɗaya ke nan ina zuwa nan."

Bayan sa'o'i huɗu, wani ma'aikaci mai suna Alhaji Barmani ya fito. Ya kalli tsofaffin, ya ce da ƙarfi, "Ku daina damun mu! Ku koma gida, sai mun kira ku." Wannan wulaƙanci ne. Malam Ɗandume ya ce, "Ranka ya daɗe, mun yi wa wannan ƙasa aiki duk rayuwarmu. Bai kamata ka wulaƙanta mu haka ba."

Alhaji Barmani bai amsa ba. Sai wani attajiri ya iso a cikin babbar mota. Alhaji Barmani ya gaishe shi da murmushi, ya kai shi ofishinsa, kuma cikin minti goma aka sa hannu a takardunsa. Malam Ɗandume ya ce a ransa, "Ana zalunta matalauta, ana girmama attajiri."

Da ya koma Funtua, ya kira wani gidan rediyo, ya ba da labarin abin da ya gani. Ya ce, "Ana zalunta tsofaffi a ofishin fansho. Ana musu wulaƙanci kamar ba mutane ba." Mutane da yawa suka kira rediyon, suka ce su ma an wulaƙanta su.

Washegari Alhaji Barmani ya kira gidan rediyon, ya ce, "Wannan ɓatanci ne. Malamin nan yana yi mini ɓatanci a gaban jama'a. Zan kai shi kotu." Amma 'yan jarida suka je ofishin, suka ɗauki hotunan tsofaffin da ke kwance a ƙasa. Hotunan sun nuna cewa labarin ba ɓatanci ba ne, gaskiya ne.

Gwamnan jihar ya ji labarin. Ya ce yana da ƙudiri na ganin an biya kowa haƙƙinsa. Bisa wannan ƙudiri, ya kafa kwamiti domin ya nemi maslaha. A ƙarshe ya kawo maslaha: a biya fansho ta banki kai tsaye, ba sai mutum ya zo Kaduna ba; kuma a buɗe ƙananan ofisoshi a kowace ƙaramar hukuma.

Majalisar zartaswa ta jihar ta amince da shawarar kwamitin, kuma gwamnati ta fara zartas da ita nan da nan.

Bayan wata biyu, Malam Ɗandume ya sami saƙo a wayarsa: an biya fanshonsa na wata goma duka. Ya kira tsohuwar da ya haɗu da ita a Kaduna. Ita ma an biya ta. Ta ce, "Allah ya saka maka da alheri. Ka cire mana wulaƙanci."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malam Ɗandume ya tafi Kaduna?
Domin wata goma ba a biya shi fansho ba.
Yaya Alhaji Barmani ya yi wa tsofaffin?
Ya wulaƙanta su, ya ce su koma gida.
Me ya faru da attajirin da ya zo?
An kai shi ofis, kuma cikin minti goma aka sa hannu a takardunsa.
Me ya sa Alhaji Barmani ya ce labarin ɓatanci ne?
Domin yana ganin Malam Ɗandume yana yi masa ɓatanci a gaban jama'a.
Wace maslaha kwamitin ya kawo?
Ya ce a biya fansho ta banki kai tsaye, kuma a buɗe ƙananan ofisoshi a kowace ƙaramar hukuma.

lessons.title: Baƙuwa daga Amurka
lessons.summary: Emily, an American student learning Hausa with a dictionary, spends a year with Salwa's family in Kano; she teaches the boys baseball while some neighbours criticise girls playing, Alhaji Hammad takes her to play golf and plays chess with her at night, she plays them jazz and they play her Hausa songs; the exchange benefits both sides and leaves a firm friendship.
lessons.text:
Emily ɗaliba ce daga Amurka. Tana karatun harshen Hausa a jami'ar ƙasarta, kuma ta zo Kano domin ta yi shekara guda a nan. Ta sauka a gidan Alhaji Hammad, tare da matarsa da 'ya'yansu. 'Yarsu Salwa tana da shekaru kamar na Emily, kuma nan da nan suka zama ƙawaye.

Emily tana tafiya da ƙamus a ko'ina. Idan ta ji wata kalma da ba ta sani ba, sai ta buɗe ƙamus ɗinta. Salwa ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Ba lallai ne ki duba ƙamus a kowane lokaci ba. Ki tambaye ni kawai." Emily ta ce, "Ƙamus ba ya gajiya da tambayoyina!"

Alhaji Hammad ya ce, "Zaman Emily a gidan nan musanya ce. Emily za ta koya mana al'adunta, mu ma mu koya mata namu. Musanya irin wannan tana da moriya ga kowa."

A Amurka, Emily tana buga wasan baseball. Wata rana ta fitar da wata sanda da ƙwallo daga jakarta, ta koya wa ƙannen Salwa yadda ake buga baseball a tsakar gida. Daga baya Salwa ma ta shiga wasan. Wasu maƙwabta suka yi kushe. Ɗaya ya ce, "Ai bai dace 'yan mata su riƙa buga wasan nan ba." Wani kuma ya kushe Alhaji Hammad saboda ya bar baƙuwa tana koya wa yaransa wasan Turawa.

Alhaji Hammad bai damu da kushe ba. Ya ce, "Walau maza ko mata, wasa yana da amfani ga lafiya. Kuma walau na Amurka ne ko na Hausawa, abin da ke da kyau, yana da kyau."

Shi kuma Alhaji Hammad yana son golf. Kowace Asabar yakan je filin golf da ke cikin birni. Ya ɗauki Emily ta bi shi. Ta yi mamaki, ta ce, "Ban taɓa buga golf ba a Amurka, sai a Kano!" Alhaji Hammad ya koya mata yadda ake riƙe sandar golf, amma ƙwallonta ta faɗa cikin ruwa sau uku.

Da dare kuma Alhaji Hammad da Emily sukan yi dara. Alhaji Hammad ya iya dara sosai. Da farko yakan ci Emily kowane dare. Amma bayan wata uku, Emily ta fara cin sa. Ya yi dariya, ya ce, "Ke ce malamar dara yanzu!"

A wasu dare kuma Emily takan kunna waƙoƙin jazz a wayarta. Ta ce, "Jazz waƙa ce da baƙaƙen Amurkawa suka fara." Salwa ta ce, "Sautin jazz ɗin nan yana kama da kiɗan kalangu." Ita kuma Salwa ta kunna wa Emily waƙoƙin Hausa, ta fassara mata kalmominsu. Emily ta rubuta sababbin kalmomi, ta duba su a ƙamus ɗinta.

Da shekarar ta ƙare, Emily ta yi kuka a filin jirgin sama. Ta ce wa Salwa, "Na zo nan domin in koyi harshe. Amma na sami iyali, da ƙwaƙƙwarar abota." Salwa ta ce, "Abotarmu ƙwaƙƙwara ce. Ba za ta ƙare ba don kin koma Amurka."

Tambayoyi:
Me Emily take yi idan ta ji kalmar da ba ta sani ba?
Takan buɗe ƙamus ɗinta.
Me Alhaji Hammad ya ce game da musanya?
Ya ce musanya irin wannan tana da moriya ga kowa.
Me ya sa wasu maƙwabta suka yi kushe?
Domin suna ganin bai dace 'yan mata su buga baseball ba.
Wane wasa ne Alhaji Hammad yake buga kowace Asabar?
Yana buga golf.
Me Emily ta ce ta samu a Kano?
Ta ce ta sami iyali, da ƙwaƙƙwarar abota.

lessons.title: Kawunan Nok a Jos
lessons.summary: Dr. Muhibba takes her children Tariq and Wafa from Zaria to the Jos museum to see the Nok clay heads; the guide explains how archaeologists mark out squares before digging, glue the broken pieces back together, and that the view that prevails is that the figures were made for the dead or kept in a temple; when a visitor calls the naked statues obscene, the guide explains that it is old art, not obscenity.
lessons.text:
Dr. Muhibba malama ce a jami'a a Zaria, kuma tana koyar da tarihi. A lokacin hutu ta kai 'ya'yanta biyu, Tariq da Wafa, gidan tarihi na ƙasa da ke Jos. Ta ce musu, "Zan nuna muku wasu kawunan mutane da aka yi da yumɓu fiye da shekara dubu biyu da suka wuce."

A cikin gidan tarihin, wani jagora ya kai su wani ɗaki mai haske. A cikin akwatunan gilashi akwai kawunan mutane da aka yi da yumɓu ja. Idanunsu manya ne, gashinsu an tsara shi da kyau. Jagoran ya ce, "Waɗannan ayyukan Nok ne. Nok wani ƙauye ne a kudancin Kaduna. Mutanen da suka yi su sun san yadda ake sarrafa yumɓu, kuma sun san ƙarfe."

Wafa ta tambaya, "Yaya aka same su?"

Jagoran ya ce, "Masu binciken tarihi suna haƙa ƙasa a hankali. Kafin su fara haƙa, sukan shata fili da igiya, su raba shi zuwa murabba'ai. Idan an shata murabba'ai, sai a san inda kowane abu ya fito. Daga nan sai su haƙa kowane murabba'i ɗaya bayan ɗaya."

Tariq ya nuna wani kai da layi a jikinsa. "Wannan ya karye?"

"Eh. Yawancin kawunan an same su a guntu guntu. Masana suka tattara guntayen, suka manna su da wani manne na musamman. Idan ka duba sosai, za ka ga inda aka manna su."

Dr. Muhibba ta tambaya, "Me masana suke cewa game da amfanin kawunan?"

Jagoran ya ce, "Akwai ra'ayoyi da dama. Wasu suna ganin an yi su ne domin mamaci: idan wani ya mutu, sai a ajiye kansa na yumɓu a kabarinsa, domin a tuna da mamacin. Wasu kuma suna ganin ana ajiye su a cikin haikali, inda mutane suke bauta. Amma ra'ayin da ya fi rinjaya a yau shi ne na farko: an yi su domin mamaci."

A wani ɗakin kuma akwai cikakkun mutane na yumɓu. Wasu daga cikinsu tsirara suke, babu tufafi a jikinsu. Wani baƙo da ke wurin ya yi fushi, ya ce, "Bai kamata a nuna wa yara waɗannan ba. Wannan batsa ce!"

Jagoran ya ce da natsuwa, "Ranka ya daɗe, ba batsa ba ce. Batsa ita ce abin da aka yi domin a tayar da sha'awa. Waɗannan ayyukan fasaha ne na da. A zamaninsu, mutane da yawa suna tafiya tsirara saboda zafi, kuma masu fasaha suna nuna mutum kamar yadda yake." Baƙon ya yi shiru, ya ci gaba da kallo.

Da suka fito, Wafa ta ce, "Mama, ra'ayinki ne ya rinjaya? Su na mamaci ne ko na haikali?" Dr. Muhibba ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Ni ma na yarda da ra'ayin farko. Amma wataƙila wata rana ke ce za ki gano gaskiya."

Tambayoyi:
Da me aka yi kawunan Nok?
An yi su da yumɓu ja.
Me masu binciken tarihi suke yi kafin su fara haƙa?
Sukan shata fili da igiya, su raba shi zuwa murabba'ai.
Me masana suka yi da guntayen kawunan?
Sun tattara su, suka manna su da wani manne na musamman.
Wane ra'ayi ne ya fi rinjaya game da amfanin kawunan?
Ra'ayin cewa an yi su domin mamaci.
Me jagoran ya ce game da mutanen yumɓu da ke tsirara?
Ya ce ba batsa ba ne, ayyukan fasaha ne na da.
